decision.explanation: Both answers are explicitly supported by the provided source texts. Document 1 (D1S12) states Clément Rosset was selected to receive the 'Knight of the Legion of Honour'. Document 2 (D2S11) states he was awarded the 'Roger Nimier Prix' in 1978. The fallible audits incorrectly flagged C0 as having a conflict or uncertain fit based on D2S11, but D2S11 supports C1, while D1S12 supports C0. There is no contradiction between receiving two different awards; they are distinct valid referents. Both are retained as valid answers.
